title: Iterates of Ritt operators close to the identity
summary: We study bounded operators whose prescribed powers remain uniformly close to the identity, and resolvent conditions sampled along sequences of powers. The displacement bound $\sup_{n\ge1}\|I-T^n\|\le q<2$ forces a finite peripheral spectrum consisting of odd-order roots of unity and makes an explicitly determined odd power of $T$ a Ritt operator. The sharp unconditional threshold for $T$ itself is $\sqrt3$.
